summary: Typosquat verdaccio plugin drops Bun runtime at preinstall to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: verdaccio-tarball-local-storage@38.1.4 typosquats the legitimate @verdaccio/local-storage plugin and lists github.com/servicetitan/uikit as its repository, impersonating ServiceTitan's public UIKit monorepo. package.json declares `scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle with hex-mangled identifiers, a shuffled string/opcode array, and a runtime decoder — its name and content are unrelated to the package's stated verdaccio-plugin purpose, and dist/index.js (a thin plugin stub serving as cover) never references it. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern (fetching Bun specifically to execute a bundled obfuscated payload outside Node's module resolution) is a scanner-evasion technique with no legitimate purpose for a verdaccio storage plugin. On `npm install`, attacker-controlled obfuscated code executes on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
